LOQUAT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Nispaereo has been auditioning for AGES now to a prestigious aerial dance show, but has been hit with rejection every time. "I just don't understand," she weeps, swallowing a large mouthful of mint chocolate chip ice cream. "They let in those talentless trapeze hacks from that circus, but they draw the line at ME?!"
LOQUAT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nispaereo creates a vortex that pulls zombies together, dealing damage.
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}changes its attack depending if it's planted on land or water

{FLAVOR}Lotus Pod came from an exotic, far-away land to showcase his expert amphibious techniques to the rest of the world. As it turns out, the only jobs he could get were all water related. 5 years of perfecting uprooting techniques down the drain...
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lotus Pod shoots out seeds when on land, and fires explosive torpedos across its lane when in water.
LOTUSPOD_TOOLTIP: Lobs seeds when on land, launches explosive torpedos when in water

LRIS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}magical birds naturally rot over time and disappear

{FLAVOR}Being a master of summoning, Iris fit in perfectly with the other magical plants. She’s in a close knit trio with Witch Hazel and Hocus Crocus, where the three of them love to gossip, go out to coffee shops, and endlessly shop together. Even if they have to deal with the occasional Wizard Zombie, they all just love the time they spend together. But despite it all, Iris misses her dear friends back home, and endlessly writes to them about her adventures.
LRIS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iris can release a magical bird from its cloak, which can continuously attack zombies and slow them down.
LRIS_TOOLTIP: Releases magical birds from its cloak that attack zombies while stalling them
LTE_EVENTS_DESC_AF2024: The time have finally come. PvZ2: Reflourished has brought the long awaited collaboration with Plants vs. Zombies 3! Join your PvZ pals to rebuild Neighborville - but be careful, this collab is limited time! Best get your Taco Tickets ready!

MADHATTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each consecutive bounce deals more damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}after the last bounce, hats have a chance to rebound, hitting the first original target
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plantfood will permanently upgrade hat, making it split into spikes upon contact

{FLAVOR}Despite his maniacal nature, offputting smile and his association with nonsense, he spends some of his time hosting tea parties with the other fairytale plants. Oftentimes, they’ll do it with hats of various sizes. He may seem like a mushroom who’s lost their marbles, but even he has some table etiquette.
MADHATTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hatter-shroom spins and launches hats that bounce into multiple zombies.
MADHATTER_TOOLTIP: Spins and launches hats that bounce into multiple zombies
MAGICSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged

{FLAVOR}With a pretty notorious history of being a successful card shark, his roll was put to a halt once some folks in Vegas caught wind of his lucky streak. Feel free to call him a Scaredy-shroom all you want for skipping town, but he's got a good cap on his stipe, and he finds it in his best interest to keep it on there as long as possible.
MAGICSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magic-shroom can be tapped on when charged to fire either freezing, sun, or plant food tarot card powers.
MAGICSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Tap when charged to release tarot card powers
MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} removes metal objects from zombies

{FLAVOR}Despite his unusual appearance, Magnet-shroom doesn't have a problem attracting girlfriends. But he does have a problem keeping them. It's the same thing every time. In the end, they always find him too clingy.
MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
MAGNETSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Removes helmets and other metal objects from zombies
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to spend 75 sun for an attack

{FLAVOR}Magnifying Grass understands the inherent power of a rainbow. Beneath her stoic features she takes great joy in delivering radiant multicolored destruction to the zombie horde.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magnifying Grass turns sun into a bolt of colorful damage.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_TOOLTIP: Tap to spend sun for a powerful attack
MAINMENU_DELETE_PROFILE_BODY: If you DELETE this profile you will lose all game play data associated with this profile including any purchased coins.
MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Marigold has dedicated herself to the Zen lifestyle. She's a team player, and gives it her best there in the garden. But if she never has to confront another zombie on the lawn again it will be too soon.
MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marigolds give you coin rewards in Zen Garden.
MARIGOLD_TOOLTIP: Gives you rewards in Zen Garden
MAX_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC: Be amazed by some not-so-simple Peashooters!
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Everyone says my head looks like a melon," said the middle child of the Pult family, "and they would be right." Don't ask him if he's seedless or not though, it offends him and frankly it's none of your business.
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.
MELONPULT_PLANTFOOD: Heavy melons are launched up that target every zombie on the lawn.
MELONPULT_TOOLTIP: Does heavy damage to groups of zombies
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, leaves behind a molten lava pool that burns zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}A recent graduate in the field of meteoritics, Meteor Flower's exhaustive work on the field finds notoriety in many a newspaper. Mostly in tabloids stating that the end of the world is nigh. Despite it all, Meteor Flower keeps their petals high and their readings accurate. They've been looking to conduct their next study near ZCorp's Printer shop, for no particular reason.
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Meteor Flowers can fire meteor strikes at any tile on the lawn, leaving behind molten lava to burn zombies.
METEORFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Tap on Meteor Flower, then a tile, to launch molten meteor strikes
MINECART_TUTORIAL_1: Drag the mine cart to a new location
MINECART_TUTORIAL_2: Great work! You can plant on empty mine carts
MINE_IS_YOURS_PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTI: Disperse {COUNT} Primal Potato Mines every {TIME} seconds!
MINT_AWARD_HEADER: You got {NUMBER} mints! Use mints to purchase and upgrade Power Mints!
MIRROR_TUTORIAL_1: Magic Mirrors are a beneficial tool that can aid you in battle.
MIRROR_TUTORIAL_2: Tap and hold the Mirror to start!
MIRROR_TUTORIAL_4: Mirrors need time to recharge before being able to be moved again.
MIRROR_TUTORIAL_6: Mirrors can deflect any card projectiles sent by the zombies.
MIRROR_TUTORIAL_7: Be sure to always utilize Mirrors to protect and retaliate against card projectiles.

{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

NARRATIVE_1000300: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{LONG}Those peashooters are confused and are just going to be in the way.
NARRATIVE_1000301: {EXCITED}{LONG}Use the shovel to dig them up and make room for useful plants!
NARRATIVE_1000452: {BRINGOUT_TACO}{SAY}{LONG}I've been holding onto this taco for forever!
NARRATIVE_1000454: {EXCITED}I want to eat THAT taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
NARRATIVE_1000455: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Her name is Penny and I'm Crazy Dave. But you can call me Crazy Dave.
NARRATIVE_1000456: {SAY:winnie}Finally, another User who can process my queries.
NARRATIVE_1000457: {TIRED:winnie}Let me postulate, Dave wants to go back in time to eat his taco... again...
NARRATIVE_1000458: {SAY:crazydave}She's so smart! Now let's go after my taco!
NARRATIVE_3800: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}I wonder if Plant Food works on other types of plants?
NARRATIVE_3900: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}{LONG}Aww...you let your plant get eaten! Try again!
NARRATIVE_4000: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}{LONG}I love the smell of coconut cannons in the morning!
NARRATIVE_4100: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{LONG}It appears the zombies have been gathered in that corral.
NARRATIVE_4102: {SAY}{MEDIUM}Better plant something before they get loose.
NARRATIVE_4200: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Oh good. There are no zombies here.
NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire with gems.
NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_AILMINT_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The Ail-mint family includes fungi and poison plants.
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_FIND_MORE_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Recognized. We have accessed an item from an alternate universe. Things such as these do not exist here.
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_INTRO_2: {EXCITED}A place where you can read about plants and zombies.
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_UPGRADE_PEASHOOTER_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}This seems to be an anomaly in the spacetime. Perhaps we should take it?
NARRATIVE_ALMANAC_UPGRADE_WALLNUT_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Looks like you can upgrade your Wallnut too!
NARRATIVE_ANTIBULLYSQUAD_TEST_1: {NPC_ENTER:antibullysquad}{EXCITED:antibullysquad}Ol' Zomboss thinks he got away with expelling us!
NARRATIVE_ANTIBULLYSQUAD_TEST_4: {EXCITED:antibullysquad}Ol' Zomboss ain't gettin' away with it this time!
NARRATIVE_ANTIBULLYSQUAD_TEST_5: {PLAYFUL:antibullysquad}Yeah. We're bad news for that boss guy.
NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire with gems.
NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_APPEASEMINT_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The Appease-mint family includes peas and other straight shooters.
NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire with gems.
NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_ARMAMINT_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The Arma-mint Family comprises various lobbing and cannon plants.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I have a bad feeling about returning to this place.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Yes. If you have not experienced the mania of Modern Day, it is recommended you do so before continuing.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}These new days of splashing insanity will be difficult to overcome without versatile plants.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}I'm afraid I cannot remember this location, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}My memory could be faulty, but there is some memory containing images of octopi.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}I took out some of your memory cards and used them to clean the Bowling Bulbs.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_5: {SHOUT:crazydave}We were back in the present and there were weird portals EVERYWHERE!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Right, I have accessed backup to my memory.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_33_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}Neighbor, if you have no idea what I'm talking about, we must've been caught in a time loop!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}...and THEN they jumped up, and I jumped too, and...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}The zombies have started approaching already. We need plants down.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}User Dave can keep on talking in the meantime.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Scans show Deep Sea Gargantuars and a horde of other zombies on the horizon.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Those are some real observant seacreatures, lemme tell ya.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Back in the day, when I went fishing...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I am convinced that your fishing trip story is very amusing but-
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}...and that's how I caught the biggest fish that ever lived.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_37_OUTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}The zombie horde has been successfully dealt with.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_38_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Scuba Zombies are submerged much deeper in water than Snorkel Zombies.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_38_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}In addition, Tangle Kelp will be unable to stop them.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_38_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}A friend of mine hates them. He keeps seeing them dive around his place.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_38_INTRO_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Very angry octopus fella. He's being hunted down for destroying some expensive buildings.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_38_INTRO_8: {TIRED:winnie}There is no creature as the one that you are describing, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_38_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's what he WANTS you to think!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we're about to rescue another plant: Homing Thistle.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Whereas other plants get their projectiles blocked by obstacles such as octopi...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}...Homing Thistle aims straight for the zombies!.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}Neat! But that means it doesn't aim for the octopi...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Well, at least my aquatic friend would like this plant.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_6: {TIRED:winnie}There is no angry octopus rampaging cities because of sushi, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Eh, you just haven't met him yet.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_39_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Sweet guy besides all the boiling rage.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}You were meant to be eliminated five steps ago!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}While my grandest plans are coming together, you're not being taken out of the equation!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}How can I continue using these PLANTS as lab rats if you keep snatching them from me!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}So that is what you're doing with them?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Well yes, besides using them as bait...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}I'd make a fish-based threat, but I ran out of good material in the pirate era.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Shame I couldn't get dramatic violins to show up and play for this occasion.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Regardless, I shall make you a watery grave now!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_OUTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}My perfect reincarnations of all the inventions cannot keep failing me!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_OUTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}You'll be under the sea when I'm through with you!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_OUTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}I'll get my needed rest, alright! And you're not going to be a part of it!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_42_OUTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}Oh, under the sea! I love that song!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. Please note the line of Banana Launchers.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Let's get to it! After all, bananas are a very a-PEELING fruit!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BANANA_4: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, if I had a head, I would be shaking it right now.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My research indicates that the sport of bowling experienced a heyday during this era.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Penny?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_3: {TIRED:winnie}I find your thought process indecipherable, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_4: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking that Bowling Bulbs would make excellent allies here.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_5: {SAY:crazydave}Huh. I was thinking how much I love wearing bowling shoes.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_BOWLING_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}So many colors ... right there on my feet!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_2: {PLAYFUL:winnie}...we need a plant with the appetite of a shark.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I catch your drift, Penny. You're talking about Chomper!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_4: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. His sharp teeth could turn the tide of battle.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, I have an idea too! We could call this Chomper Week!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_CHOMPER_6: {TIRED:winnie}If we must, User Dave. If we must.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2: {SAY:crazydave}It's got everything a growing plant needs!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4: {SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. My sensors indicate there are zombies on your beach...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5: {SAY:winnie}... and far too much water. It will overwhelm the plants.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6: {SAY:crazydave}No problem-o! We'll just lay down some Lily Pads.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}Then the other plants can ride the waves!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Or as the vernacular of this era goes: They can "hang ten."
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Listen up, dudes! I'm here to totally bum you out.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2: {SAY}Way down deep, there's a certain creep...
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3: {SAY}When he swims up, your brains he'll keep!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_6: {TIRED:winnie}He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Dudes, like, you're totally in for it now!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_2: {SAY}The Deep Sea Gargantuars have their slimy sights on you.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_4: {SAY}But you can't escape their scaly grip!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_ALT_6: {TIRED:winnie}He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I tell ya, Penny, these surf-loving zombies are the pits!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_3: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Hmmm. Pits. Very interesting. User Dave! You are a genius!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_5: {TIRED:winnie}No. No you are not. However, you have given me an idea.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_6: {EXCITED:winnie}Guacodile! This plant fights zombies with pit-like projectiles.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_7: {SAY:winnie}And he employs a powerful bite as well.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_GUACODILE_8: {EXCITED:winnie}Plant him on the front lines. You'll see.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Whew! Fighting zombies that arrive in waves AND tides isn't easy.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}You know what we need, Penny? An ally with a lot of 'tude!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_3: {SAY:crazydave}And by 'tude, I mean attitude. In case you need translation.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_4: {SAY:winnie}Then I suggest we call upon Homing Thistle.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_5: {SAY:winnie}I believe he has this 'tude you speak of.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}His eyes! Intense! He can shoot the zombies a real mean look.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_7: {EXCITED:winnie}More importantly, he can shoot deadly darts that home in on their target.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_HOMINGTHISTLE_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}Two painful blows for the price of one! Radical!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, data suggests that we should beware the tides.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_2: {SAY:crazydave}When the tide comes in, it'll be a WIPE OUT for our plant friends?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_3: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. But the tide line indicates how high the water will rise. Plan accordingly.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_TIDES_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}The tide comes in, the tide goes out. Who can explain it?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Yo beach bums! Don't flip your lid.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SAY:zombossicon}But have you noticed that Chomper and Bikini Zombie have been ultra cozy lately?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Could a beachside plant-zombie romance be in bloom?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Speaking of which, how sure are you of Chomper's loyalties?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {SAY:zombossicon}I can't help but notice ... that plant has the appetite of a zombie.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6:
{SAY:zombossicon}Chew on that land lovers! Later dudes!
Dr. Zomboss
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}A plant-zombie romance? Penny ... my mind is BLOWN!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, do not jump to conclusions. I suggest something more productive.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Alert! I've detected a strange statue of surfing-era significance.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Well lookie there! It's a tiki statue. With crazy eyes.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3: {SAY:winnie}Analysis indicates this tiki could inflict a terrifying challenge upon any who follow it.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}So you're saying that a tiki torture awaits? Get it? A tiki TORCH-er?
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_5:
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I must say, your pun is...
TORCH-er-ous.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SHOUT:crazydave}And I know a thing or two about craaaazy!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {SAY:winnie}I concur. I suspect Dr. Zomboss was attempting to sow seeds of discontent.
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {SAY:crazydave}From now on, we are the only ones sowing seeds around here!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Totally bogus! Little do you know what I have in store for you!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_6: {SAY:zombossicon}The seeds of destruction have been planted! Brace yourselves for a wipe out!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_7: {SAY:zombossicon}But for now, I gotta split. Catch you dweebs later!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Look! It must be time to play Beach Zombie Bungo!
NARRATIVE_BEACH_ZOMBIENOTE_3: {SAY:crazydaveicon}You already won, Penny? Wow. You're good at this!
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
NARRATIVE_BEGHOULED_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}You can use sun to upgrade the plants.
NARRATIVE_BLASTBERRYVINE_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vines are special plants that can be planted on top of other plants.
NARRATIVE_BLASTBERRYVINE_EQ_2: {SAY:winnie}Plant Blastberry Vines on other plants for an offensive boost!
NARRATIVE_BOINGSETTA_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Boingsettas to destroy grid items as well as knock back and chill zombies.
NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire with gems.
NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_BOMBARDMINT_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The Bombard-mint Family is made up of explosive plants.
NARRATIVE_BOOMBALLOON_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Boom Balloon Flower to spawn draggable balloon mines.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Some levels may have Buffz & Bruisez active.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}This means zombies can be weak, resistant, or immune to damage from certain plant families.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies are WEAK to plants in the Fila-mint family.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ01_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do a lot of damage.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Buffz & Bruisez can work the other way as well.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Zombies can resist damage from certain plant families.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies RESIST damage from plants in the Fila-mint family.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ02_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do less damage than normal.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}At the greatest extreme, Buffz & Bruisez can nullify a plant family completely.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies are IMMUNE to damage from plants in the Fila-mint family.
NARRATIVE_BUFFZ03_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do no damage. Use them as blockers!
NARRATIVE_BUY_PLANTFOOD_3: {SPECIAL4}Here neighbor, have some moola! Why? Because I'm CRAAAZY!
NARRATIVE_BUY_POWERUPS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{LONG}If you want to use a Power Up, you can buy one with coins!
